connector.name: SlideForge
connector.registryDescription: Deterministic, fully editable PowerPoint from typed slide intents. 150+ layouts, brand templates.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.slideforge.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package slideforge-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.slideforge. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SLIDEFORGE_API_KEY
env.description: SlideForge API key (starts with sf_live_). Required to run tool calls; schema discovery works without it. Get one at https://slideforge.dev.
